text: ‍EL PAÍS: The latest massacre to hit Mexico: Business owners, local officials and bodies hung from a bridge July 22, 2026 | 🟢 📰 EL PAÍS reconstructs the Zacatecas massacre: ten men kidnapped and murdered, five bodies hung from a bridge in Pánuco. ‍AP/ABC: US says it will begin lifting suspension of Mexican cattle imports starting in August July 25, 2026 | 🟢 📰 AP: USDA will start reopening the border to Mexican cattle Aug. 24 at Douglas, Arizona — after screwworm turned up in Texas and New Mexico despite the year-long ban. Sheinbaum: "dialogue, cooperation, and collaboration with mutual respect." 🇲🇽 The suspension cost Mexican ranchers multimillion-dollar losses while the parasite was detected on the US side anyway. • "the reopening of cattle imports from Mexico will begin at the Douglas, Arizona border crossing" • "the screwworm was detected last month in Texas and southeastern New Mexico" • "dialogue, cooperation, and collaboration with mutual respect" — Sheinbaum

text: ‍USA TODAY: Trump jokes about tariffs for Mexico's lettuce, Canada's wildfire smoke July 24, 2026 | 🤡 📰 🤡 Trade policy as open-mic night: Trump "joked" he'll slap a "major tariff" on Mexico over lettuce and a "big tariff" on Canada over wildfire smoke. USA Today relays it as a quip — no mention that tariffs are paid by US importers, or that a tariff can't kill a pathogen. The lettuce outbreak — 1,600+ sick across 34 states per CDC — is a food-safety story; the tariff punchline became the headline anyway. • "I think we'll put a major tariff on Mexico because of the lettuce" • "we'll put a big tariff on Canada because of the smoke" • "safe to eat lettuce again" — Fox's Peter Doocy, setting up the bit

‍FT: Mexico's Claudia Sheinbaum puts faith in petrol price cap July 25, 2026 | 🟡 📰 The FT discovers Mexico's fuel price cap and files it under ideology: "a window into the ideology and modus operandi of Sheinbaum," part of "the populist vision." The authority quoted: business leaders "wary" of "interventionist policies." 🔍 Left out: the cap is a voluntary pact with retailers cushioned by fuel-tax relief the government absorbs — the "tightening supply" claim comes from unnamed executives. (Paywalled; analysis from indexed text.) • "a window into the ideology and modus operandi of Sheinbaum" • "Business leaders wary of president's interventionist policies" — subhead • "several executives say is already tightening supply and will be hard to sustain"

‍CNN: For years, the US went after Mexico's drug lords. Now it's looking at the politicians July 25, 2026 | 🟢 📰 CNN on Washington's pivot from capos to politicians — and for once the Mexican side gets the mic: Sheinbaum's sovereignty objections, analysts warning the move risks "poisoning the waters" of security cooperation, and a rare nod to US drug demand and gun flows. 🇲🇽 CNN notes the cartels "are also fortified by strong US demand for drugs and the illegal flow of American guns" — the context this genre usually omits. • "well-heeled politicians who allegedly accept dirty money to help the criminals" • "they risk poisoning the waters of bilateral security cooperation" — USC's Pamela Starr • "Is this a legitimate interest to fight organized crime?" — Sheinbaum
